title: Your turn

data.question: Sam deposits $1,000 at 5% a year, compounded once a year, and withdraws nothing. Which calculation gives Sam's balance after 3 years?
data.explanation: Compounding multiplies the balance by 1.05 every year, so three years give about $1,157.63. A is simple interest, C uses 5 instead of 0.05, and D is only the simple interest amount.
